message.content:
Change the copy constructor to move the two vectors out of the source instead of deep-copying them; this turns O(n) copies into O(1) pointer steals for the decoder's temporary `FieldBase` objects.

```include
#include <utility>
```

```cpp
FieldBase::FieldBase(const FieldBase &field)
    : values(std::move(const_cast<FieldBase&>(field).values)),
      stringIndexes(std::move(const_cast<FieldBase&>(field).stringIndexes))
{
}
```
